name: io.github.BrightWayAI/video-analyzer
description: Turn any video link into a shot-by-shot storyboard: frames, transcript and a style fingerprint.

tools.name: video_analyze
tools.description: Full breakdown: shot-by-shot storyboard with frames, Claude Vision descriptions, transcript, contact sheet and stylistic fingerprint

tools.name: video_extract_frames
tools.description: Extract one representative frame per shot using scene detection (or fixed intervals)

tools.name: video_transcribe
tools.description: Timestamped transcript of a video's audio (Whisper, runs locally)

tools.name: video_fingerprint
tools.description: 8-field Stylistic Fingerprint v3: rendering, world, characters, narrative, abstraction, density, editing, tone

tools.name: video_compare
tools.description: Compare two videos side by side: fingerprint, pacing, hook and structure, plus what each could borrow from the other (hosted)

tools.name: video_check_deps
tools.description: Verify FFmpeg, Whisper and the other local dependencies are installed (local installs only)
